doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Opening and welcome
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Jack Sheldon and the Hamilton archive project.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Los Angeles filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Jack Sheldon with me today, who is a trumpet player, vocalist and I’ve heard, outgoing personality.
Thank you, I’m so glad to be here. I think this is such a great thing you’re doing.
Uh huh. The history of jazz as told by the people who do it.
You’re a product of the early 1930s in Jacksonville?
